# Tacos El Takin

> Taco Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. Pastor, asada and chorizo tacos, burritos and tortas, with a self serve salsa bar.

- Phone: (210) 815-6910
- Address: 13131 El Sendero St, San Antonio, TX 78233
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Burritos; Tortas; Loaded fries and salsas
- Rating: 4.8 from 341 Google reviews
